Money · in French

Savings goals and emergency fund

An emergency fund sized in months of essential expenses, a home deposit, a car, a trip: each goal gets its budget line by line, a monthly deposit and the month you reach it, or the deposit needed to hit your date. Three compound-interest scenarios at the rate you enter (no bank rates built in), milestones and a deposit log. A calculation aid, not financial advice.
